q: The spectrum of the Koopman operator U_T on L²(μ) determines dynamical properties. Weak mixing is equivalent to U_T having:
exp: Weak mixing ↔ Koopman operator has no eigenvalues other than λ = 1 (of multiplicity 1). Equivalently, for all f ∈ L²: (1/N)Σ |⟨U_T^n f, f⟩|² → |⟨f,1⟩|². Weak mixing is strictly between ergodicity (Cesàro) and strong mixing (convergence).
